episodes.title: Internet Band
episodes.topic: What if the whole world's internet went down for 24 hours (timeline 1 s -> 1 h -> 6 h -> 12 h -> 24 h)
episodes.why: Story-led reels beat pure-science ones on this page (Hamid reels ~1,000-1,400 views vs the 'dharti ghoomna band' science What If 187 views, 45.6% skip); internet/tech blackout what-ifs are an evergreen viral format and relatable.
episodes.note: First cut (Kamran M narrator, fast) was pulled before 22:00 at the owner's request. Re-cut: narrator Sunny Singh (owner's pick), curious storytelling with turns ('socho…', 'lekin…', 'aur phir…'), short pauses.

episodes.title: Gravity Gayab
episodes.topic: What if Earth lost gravity for 7 seconds (timeline 1 s -> 3 s -> 5 s -> 7 s 'dharaam'); ends calling out the 12 August 2026 'Project Anchor' gravity hoax
episodes.why: Last 30 days on IG: What If #1 (story-led, Internet Band) 213 views / 34% skip vs the science-only What If 187 / 45.6%; Hamid story reels 1,000-1,400 with a strong hook. The 7-second gravity hoax (Project Anchor) is 2026's biggest viral what-if; told as a Hamid story with the hoax called a hoax.

episodes.title: Future Se Message
episodes.topic: What if you got a message from yourself, 1 year in the future (raat 12 baje -> 1 minute -> saari raat -> subah paper); twist: Bilal's prank; ends calling the 'Remember November 2026' AI meme just a meme
episodes.why: Last 30 days IG: What If #1 Internet Band grew to 1,242 views / 30.6% skip (story-led works); #2 Gravity Gayab 390 views / 34.3% skip on day 1; Hamid reels 1,000-1,400 with strong hooks. Web: the 'Remember November 2026' AI 'meme from the future' (revived late Aug 2026, now in its month) - a future-message what-if, told as a Hamid story with the meme called a meme.

episodes.title: Smog Ghayab
episodes.topic: What if Lahore's air was totally clean for one day (subah 7 baje -> 1 ghanta -> raat 9 baje -> agli subah); Bilal sells 'taaza hawa' bottles, stars over Lahore; twist: smog wapis - saaf hawa jaadu se nahi aati, dhuaan kam karna padta hai
episodes.why: Last 30 days IG: #2 Gravity Gayab grew to 1,259 views / 31.5% skip, #1 Internet Band 1,244 / 30.7%, #3 Future Se Message 163 / 24.8% after 1 day; Hamid reels 1,000-1,400 with strong hooks. Web: Lahore smog is the hot local news of November 2026 (AQI 535 on 3 Nov, world's most polluted city) -> hopeful 'one clean day' what-if with the real fact stated.

episodes.title: Reels Band
episodes.topic: What if all reels were switched off for one week (1 minute -> 1 ghanta -> 3 din -> 7 din): thumb keeps scrolling, people say salaam on the street, Bilal goes 'LIVE' on the street and falls (0 views), Ammi heard in full, Abbu's old stories, Hamid sleeps at 11 pm; twist: reels return on day 7 and Hamid puts the phone down; ends calling the Nov 2026 viral reels-app ban notification fake (PTA)
episodes.why: Last 30 days IG: What If #1 Internet Band 1,245 / 30.8% skip, #2 Gravity Gayab 1,259 / 31.5%, #3 Future Se Message 166 / 25.0%, #4 Smog Ghayab 150 / 41.7% (day 1, highest skip - local/serious topic weaker than tech/phone ones); Hamid reels alternate ~1,000-1,400 vs 140-210. Web: 5 Nov 2026 a fake notification claiming a TikTok ban in Pakistan went viral; PTA called it misleading -> phone/reels what-if, told as a Hamid story with the rumour called fake.

episodes.title: Gas 24 Ghante
episodes.topic: What if gas never went off for one winter day (subah 6 baje -> dopahar 12 -> shaam 5 -> raat 11 -> agle mahine): first hot-water bath from the geyser, Ammi cooks parathe/halwa/nihari (pet full), Bilal's Rs 10/balti garam paani thela (lambi line), whole mohalla sleeps warm; twist: Rs 48,500 gas bill, Abbu behosh; ends with the real fact (winter 2026 Punjab: gas only at cooking hours) and calls it just a story
episodes.why: Last 30 days IG: What If #1 Internet Band 1,246 views / 30.7% skip, #2 Gravity Gayab 1,260 / 31.6%, #3 Future Se Message 169 / 25.3%, #4 Smog Ghayab 221 / 39.9%, #5 Reels Band 149 / 43.2% (day 1); no saves/shares to speak of; Hamid reels still alternate ~1,000-1,400 vs 115-250. Web: no new global what-if viral; Pakistan's winter gas load-shedding is the big household story of Nov 2026 (SNGPL/SSGC winter timings from early Nov, homes without gas ~16 h/day, cooking hours only) -> funny everyday-comfort what-if with a bill twist.

episodes.title: Duniya Khatam Kal
episodes.topic: What if the world ended in 24 hours (24 ghante baaqi -> 12 -> 3 -> raat 11:59 -> agli subah): Hamid says sorry to Ammi, Bilal confesses he always ate Hamid's samosas, Hamid spends all savings on free biryani for the mohalla; twist: next morning the world is fine and Hamid's pocket is empty; ends saying the viral '13 November 2026 doomsday' was von Foerster's 1960 population formula, not a prophecy
episodes.why: Last 30 days IG: What If #1 Internet Band 1,246 views / 30.7% skip, #2 Gravity Gayab 1,260 / 31.6% (both big-shock hooks), #3 169 / 25.3%, #4 224 / 40.3%, #5 185 / 42.4%, #6 Gas 24 Ghante 95 views / 32.6% skip (day 1); no saves, ~1 share; Hamid reels ~1,000-1,400 vs 120-480. Web: the '13 November 2026 doomsday' (Heinz von Foerster's 1960 Science paper) went viral in Oct-Nov 2026 -> big world-scale shock hook (like #1/#2) told as a relatable family story, the viral claim called just a calculation.
